calls.transcript:
agent: This is a scripted demonstration. I am Pramanik, following up on three reports about potholes at Vidya School's west gate. Who will handle the repair?
officer: I am Meera Deshmukh, the ward civil works engineer. My team is responsible for this road. We will patch both potholes within two days.
agent: I have saved that deadline. Residents will check the surface after your team finishes.

calls.summary: The agent recalled the earlier promise. Meera reported the patch repair finished; residents subsequently confirmed a usable surface.
calls.nextAction: Compare the resident checks before closing the case.

agent: Meera, I am following up on the two day repair promise for Vidya School's west gate. Three households reported the same potholes. What has changed?

agent: Thank you. I will record this as your completion claim and ask residents to verify the repair before closing the case.
